source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Once both players have finished deploying, if your army has at least 1 model with this ability, you may pick up to 3 **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY** units of yours and set them all up again. Any of them may go into **Strategic Reserves** instead, however many units are already there.

ability.when: after both players have deployed their armies
ability.condition: your army includes at least 1 model with this ability
